recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless a future Vocabulary work-group decision changes ValueSet.compose terminology.
issue_request: FHIR-16432 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for STU3. It requested changing the ValueSet.compose short definition from "Definition of the content of the value set" to "Content logical definition of the value set (CLD)", without renaming the compose element.

Later source refactoring preserved that wording in source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists valueset=ValueSet as an active resource entry and marks ValueSet as a normative conformance resource, confirming current build scope. Current ValueSet.compose also keeps Content Logical Definition wording in its longer definition and aliases. Community searches found no direct Zulip or Confluence evidence conflicting with the Jira and source history; Confluence block-vote material lists tracker 16432 with the same Persuasive with Modification disposition.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml already has ValueSet.compose.short set to "Content logical definition of the value set (CLD)".
